window.title: JKNet Chat
window.onTopNote: Stays on top of the game in windowed or borderless mode. Exclusive fullscreen hides it.

surface.pick: Pick a chat on the left, or press Message next to a friend.

notConfigured.title: Chats are not switched on
notConfigured.text: This build of JKNet has no JKNet Online service to keep chats on.

signedOut.title: Sign in to chat
signedOut.text: Chats live on JKNet Online. Sign in on the Settings screen to talk to your friends.

noChat.title: Chats are not available yet
noChat.text: The JKNet Online service does not have chats yet. They appear here as soon as it does.

failed.title: Chats could not be loaded
failed.text: Something went wrong while reading your chats.

list.offline: Reconnecting. Messages are sent once the connection is back.
list.noServerChat: No server chat right now. It appears while your private server runs and is deleted when it stops.
list.empty: No chats yet. Press Message next to a friend on the Friends screen to start one.
list.serverNote: A server chat exists while the private server runs. It is deleted when the server stops.

group.newBody: Up to {{max}} members, you included. Messages and files are kept for 90 days.
group.name: Name
group.namePlaceholder: Optional. Without a name, the group shows its members
group.full: The group is full: it can have up to {{max}} members.
group.noFriends: You have no friends to add yet. Add friends on the Friends screen first.
group.allIn: All your friends are already in this group.
group.asksNote: A friend who asks before being added to groups gets an invitation and joins after accepting it.
group.addBody: Any member can add their friends. Friends who ask first get an invitation instead.

report.invited: Asked first, so they got an invitation: {{names}}
report.full: No room left in the group: {{names}}
report.cooldown: Declined an invitation to this group a moment ago, try again tomorrow: {{names}}

info.title: Group info
info.serverByYou: Private server chat · you are the host
info.renamePlaceholder: Without a name, the group shows its members
info.creator: Creator
info.ruleOwner: Any member can add their friends. Only you can rename the group and remove members.
info.ruleMember: Any member can add their friends. Only {{name}}, the creator, can rename the group and remove members.
info.ruleServer: Only the host can remove players from this chat.
info.historyHint: Applies to members who join after you change it.
info.historyOn: New members also see messages sent before they joined.
info.historyOff: New members see only messages sent after they join.
info.historyOwnerOnly: Only {{name}}, the creator, can change this.
info.historyHostOnly: The host changes this on the Play with friends screen.
info.historyHostHere: Change it on the Play with friends screen while the server runs.
info.leaveText: Leave {{title}}? You stop getting its messages until a member adds you back.
info.leaveHandover: Leave {{title}}? You created it, so {{name}} becomes the group creator: the role passes to the member who joined earliest.
info.leaveDelete: Leave {{title}}? You are the last member, so the group and its history are deleted.
info.leaveServerText: Leave the chat of this server? You stop getting its messages. You come back when you join the server again.
info.leaveEndText: End the chat of your server? It is deleted for everyone in it. The server keeps running.
info.removeBody: {{name}} stops getting messages from this group. Any member can add {{name}} back later.
info.removeServerBody: {{name}} stops getting messages from this chat.

invites.title: Group invitations
invites.bannerText: Join to read the chat and write to the group.
invites.historyNote: The group creator decides whether new members see the messages sent before they join.
invites.askNote: You asked to be invited instead of added to groups, so the group waits for your answer.

search.title: Messages
search.startThis: Type a word to search this chat.
search.startAll_one: Type at least {{count}} character to search all chats.
search.startAll_other: Type at least {{count}} characters to search all chats.
search.none: Nothing found in the last 90 days
search.retention: Search covers the last 90 days: older messages and files are deleted.

system.serverStarted: The server chat started. It is deleted when the server stops.

thread.gone: This chat is no longer available.
thread.emptyText: Say hi to {{name}}. Messages and files are kept for 90 days.
thread.emptyServer: Talk to everybody on your private server. This chat is deleted when the server stops.
thread.retention: Messages and files are kept for 90 days.
thread.retentionServer: This chat is deleted when the server stops.
thread.historyHidden: You joined later. Earlier messages are hidden.
thread.historyHiddenGroup: The group creator can turn on “New members see history” for people who join after that.
thread.historyHiddenServer: The host can turn on “New members see history” for guests who join after that.
thread.readOnly: Read-only: you are no longer friends

notify.allHint: Notify me about every new message
notify.mentionsHint: Notify me only when somebody mentions me or replies to me
notify.muteHint: No notifications; mentions still notify you

reply.missing: The original message is no longer available

reactions.limit: You can add up to three reactions to a message

reasons.fileNotReady: a file has not finished uploading
reasons.fileGone: a file is no longer available
reasons.fileTooLarge: a file is larger than 25 MiB
reasons.quotaAccount: your 1 GiB of chat files is full
reasons.quotaStore: the service has no room for files right now
reasons.hashMismatch: a file changed while it was uploading
reasons.sizeMismatch: a file changed while it was uploading
reasons.network: JKNet Online could not be reached
reasons.rateLimited: too many messages, wait a minute
reasons.notFound: the chat is no longer available
reasons.internal: JKNet Online has a problem, try again later

composer.tooManyCards: A message can carry up to {{max}} cards.
composer.tooManyFiles: A message can carry up to {{max}} files.
composer.tooLong: A message can be up to {{max}} characters long.
composer.notFriends: You are no longer friends. The chat is read-only; once you are friends again, it picks up where it left off.
composer.deletedPeer: This account was deleted. The chat is read-only and is kept until the 90-day limit.
composer.readOnly: You cannot send messages to this chat.

attach.limits: Up to 25 MiB per file. Files are kept for 90 days.

files.gone: This file is no longer available. Files are kept for 90 days.
files.danger: Executable file. Open it only if you trust {{name}}.
files.dangerExt: Executable file (.{{ext}}). Open it only if you trust {{name}}.

image.addToMediaHint: Save it with the screenshots of {{client}}

demo.addHint: Put it into the demos of {{client}}
demo.added: Added to Media: it is in the demos of {{client}}.

cards.unknown: Update JKNet to see this card.
cards.label: {{kind}}: {{title}}
cards.noClient: Add a {{game}} client on the Clients screen first.

server.offline: The server does not answer right now.

hostInvite.relay: Through the JKNet relay, no port forwarding
hostInvite.stopped: This server is not running any more.

bundle.unavailable: This bundle is no longer in the catalogue.

jkhubMod.conflicts: Files with the same names are already installed. Replace them from the JKHub tab of the Library.
jkhubMod.external: JKHub hosts this file on another site. Open it on JKHub.
jkhubMod.noPk3: The archive holds no pk3 files. Open it on JKHub to see what it holds.
jkhubMod.unsupported: JKNet cannot open a {{format}} archive. Open it on JKHub.

map.busy: Your private server is starting or stopping.
map.otherGame: Your private server runs the other game.
map.started: Your private server is starting on {{map}}.
map.changeBody: The mode stays {{mode}}. Everybody on the server loads the new map.
map.hostBody: Your private server starts with the last settings of the Play with friends screen, the client {{client}} and the mode {{mode}}.
map.hostLoading: Reading the maps of your client…
map.hostNoClient: Pick a client that can host on the Play with friends screen first.
map.notInstalled: {{client}} does not have this map. Install it into the client first.
map.noMode: This map offers no mode your server can run.

dangers.title_one: {{count}} command to check before you use it
dangers.title_other: {{count}} commands to check before you use it
dangers.incomplete: The text is too complex to check to the end. Read all of it before you save it.

reasons.exec: runs another config file, which JKNet cannot see
reasons.writeConfig: writes your settings to a file
reasons.rcon: uses the remote console of a server
reasons.reconnect: connects to the last server again
reasons.allowDownload: lets servers put files into your game folder
reasons.filesystem: changes where the game reads and writes files
reasons.nestedBind: changes your key binds when a key is pressed
reasons.tooComplex: could not be checked to the end

config.title: New config from the chat
config.body: Read the marked lines before you save. The config is saved on the Configs screen; turn it on for a client there.
config.name: Name
config.skipped: These keys cannot be written to a config and were left out: {{keys}}

profile.title: Save {{name}} as a player profile
profile.body: Check the profile and save it into one of your clients. Nothing changes until you press Save profile.
profile.skipped: Some values could not be used and were left blank: {{fields}}

apply.title: Save {{name}} with these commands?
apply.body: The config still has commands that do more than change a setting. Save it only if you trust the player who sent it.

save.title: Save {{name}}?
save.body: {{name}} sent a file that can run on your computer. JKNet never opens it; save it only if you trust the sender.
save.archive: This archive holds programs, or JKNet cannot look inside it.
save.marked: The saved copy is marked as downloaded from the internet, so Windows asks again before it runs.

pickers.narrow_one: {{count}} more. Type to narrow the list.
pickers.narrow_other: {{count}} more. Type to narrow the list.
pickers.noClient: Add a client of this game on the Clients screen first.

media.title: Attach from Media
media.empty: No demos, screenshots or videos of this game on the Media screen yet.

server.title: Share a server
server.empty: No servers yet. Press Get new list on the Servers screen.

profile.title: Share a player profile
profile.empty: This client has no player profiles yet.

bind.title: Share key binds
bind.body: Binds of your saved configs. Pick up to 50; they go as one card.
bind.empty: Your saved configs have no key binds. Set some on the Configs screen first.

config.title: Share a config
config.empty: No saved configs of this game yet. Make one on the Configs screen.
config.tooLarge: Larger than 32 KiB: send the .cfg as a file instead.

share.title: Share to chat
share.unavailable: Sign in on the Settings screen to share to your chats.

emoji.title: Emoji
emoji.failed: The emoji could not be loaded.

link.title: Open a link to {{host}}?
link.body: Links in messages are written by other players. Check the address before you open it in your browser.

removed.account_deleted: The chat with a deleted account was removed

hostChat.title: Server chat
hostChat.text: Friends who join your server can talk to everybody on it. The chat is deleted when the server stops.
hostChat.historyHint: When off, people who join see only messages sent after they join. A change applies to people who join after it.
hostChat.pending: The chat opens once JKNet Online sees your server running. The switch works from then on.
hostChat.ended: You ended the chat of this server. It stays closed until you start the server again.
